review_topic: software architecture of entity resolution systems
additional_context: Apply these rules only to the title, abstract, and minimal bibliographic metadata. Do not infer architecture or implementation details that are not stated.

inclusion_criteria.label: published 2010-2025
inclusion_criteria.description: published between 2010 and 2025 and written in English

inclusion_criteria.label: er software
inclusion_criteria.description: the title or abstract refers to a tool, framework, system, library, or software architecture for entity resolution or entity matching

inclusion_criteria.label: original work
inclusion_criteria.description: the title or abstract indicates that the paper presents or evaluates original work rather than only discussing prior work

exclusion_criteria.label: secondary study
exclusion_criteria.description: is identified as a review, survey, tutorial, position paper, or another secondary study

exclusion_criteria.label: matching subproblem only
exclusion_criteria.description: the title or abstract focuses only on a matching technique or subproblem such as blocking, clustering, classification, or filtering, without referring to a software artifact

exclusion_criteria.label: domain-specific only
exclusion_criteria.description: the title or abstract describes only a domain-specific application or case study and does not indicate a generic entity resolution tool, system, framework, or architecture
